title: Air Street becomes one of the largest solo VCs in Europe with $232M fund
description: London’s Air Street Capital has raised a large Fund III with eyes locked on backing early-stage European and North American AI companies.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Bernie Sanders’ AI ‘gotcha’ video flops, but the memes are great
description: Sen. Bernie Sanders thinks he's tricked Claude into revealing the AI industry's secrets, but he really just exposed how agreeable chatbots can become.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Vibe-coding startup Lovable is on the hunt for acquisitions
description: Lovable's founder said the fast-growing vibe-coding startup is looking for startups and teams to join its company.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Apple sets June date for WWDC 2026, teasing ‘AI advancements’
description: Apple will host its next Worldwide Developers Conference the week of June 8. The company is expected to announce major updates to Siri with advanced AI capabilities.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Littlebird raises $11M for its AI-assisted ‘recall’ tool that reads your computer screen
description: Littlebird is building an AI that reads your screen in real time to capture context, answer questions, and automate tasks, without relying on screenshots.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Startup Gimlet Labs is solving the AI inference bottleneck in a surprisingly elegant way
description: Gimlet Labs just raised an $80 million Series A for tech that lets AI run across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, ARM, Cerebras and d-Matrix chips, simultaneously.
author: Julie Bort

title: Elizabeth Warren calls Pentagon’s decision to bar Anthropic ‘retaliation’
description: In a letter to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-MA) equated the DOD's decision to label Anthropic a "supply-chain risk" as retaliation, arguing that the Pentagon could simply have terminated its contract with the AI lab.
author: Ram Iyer
